thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High latency SLO alerts for smart-routing p95 in us-east-1. alert=sr-p95-2110000000. Paging on-call.

sam: i'm oncall. pulling smart-routing telemetry and model variant metrics. tagging @anya for model-selection profile context.

anya: quick read: model-variant latency histogram shows variant-b has a bimodal tail for long sequences today. fallback logic is preferring variant-b intermittently when p95 crosses 1.0s. hold_time/hysteresis appears to be zero for this policy.

paul: paul (routing lead) joining. can you paste the routing decision stream? need to see timestamps to confirm flip frequency.

sam: paste from routing-audit (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T15:12:01Z decision id=rc-9001 route=us-east-1 from=variant-a -> variant-b reason=fallback p95=1.12s
2026-03-15T15:12:25Z decision id=rc-9002 route=us-east-1 from=variant-b -> variant-a reason=policy_rebalance p95=0.82s
2026-03-15T15:12:49Z decision id=rc-9003 route=us-east-1 from=variant-a -> variant-b reason=fallback p95=1.31s
2026-03-15T15:13:13Z decision id=rc-9004 route=us-east-1 from=variant-b -> variant-a reason=policy_rebalance p95=0.79s
```
Looks like ~24s flip intervals.

tia: tia (ops) here. customer impact: two customers reported slow responses (nlpstream, marketvox). Observed client-side retries increased; some requests got 504s. CS notified them with an initial message.

infra-bot: autoscale events: no recent infra shortages. GPU utilization stable at ~62%. No zone failures.

anya: hypothesis: perf profiles used by the fallback selector were last updated 48h ago and don't reflect today's longer sequences. variant-b latency estimate was stale; fallback picks it thinking capacity/perf tradeoff is better.

paul: immediate mitigation options?

sam: suggested short mitigation plan:
- set policy hold_time=180s for p95 triggers in us-east-1
- temporarily disable automatic fallback to variant-b in the route config
- pin variant-a for 45m while we stabilize
- send customer comms update

tia: please also trigger on-call handoff note so second-shift picks this up.

sam: executing control-plane updates now.
```
PATCH /control/routes/us-east-1
{ "auto_fallback": false, "hold_time": "180s", "pinned_variant": "variant-a", "pin_ttl": "45m" }
--> 200 OK
```

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: route_patch by sam at 2026-03-15T15:14:08Z. auto_fallback=false hold_time=180s pinned_variant=variant-a ttl=45m.

paul: adding a short-term traffic-weighting as a guard: reducing weight to variant-b to 10% so even if chosen it's limited.

sam: CLI:
```
redwood route set-weight us-east-1 variant-b 10%
-> OK
```

tia: CS update sent: "We've applied mitigations to stabilize routing and expect normal latency within 10-20 minutes. We're investigating root cause and will share a postmortem." sent to nlpstream, marketvox.

anya: after mitigations p95 is decreasing. metrics snapshot: pre-mitigation p95 ~1.35s, now trending to ~0.85s within 6 minutes. flip-flops stopped.

paul: action items for follow-up:
- audit perf-profile freshness and add heartbeat to re-estimate profiles weekly
- add default hysteresis on p95-based reroutes (>=120s)
- add an integration test that simulates long-sequence tail and ensures weight-based fallback doesn't flip rapidly
- investigate why variant-b latency is bimodal (sequence-length dependent)

sam: logging incident severity: Sev3 - partial degradation with customer impact (intermittent slow responses). starting postmortem doc and assigning follow-ups.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: sr-p95-2110000000 mitigation applied; monitoring. closing when stable for 30m.

paul: I'll open a PR to change default policy template and add a guard to not pick variants with stale estimates. assigning to @anya for perf-profile audit.

anya: acknowledged. will run a quick rebench and update profiles; will also add an alert for profile-staleness.

tia: leaving handoff note for night shift: "Mitigation in place: auto_fallback disabled, hold_time 180s, variant-a pinned until 15:59 UTC. Monitor p95 and routing-decision stream. If p95 climbs back >1.2s for >5m, escalate to routing oncall."

sam: handing off to night oncall now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - sr-p95-2110000000 closed at 2110000180. Summary: routing oscillation due to aggressive p95-triggered fallback combined with stale variant performance estimates. Mitigation: disabled auto-fallback, added 180s hold_time, lowered variant-b weight, pinned variant-a for 45m. Follow-ups: perf-profile audit, default hysteresis, integration test, and stale-profile alert.
